content.text: Yes, but there are no links to the official FastAPI website (fastapi.tiangolo.com). The links that exist point to your own backend's auto-generated docs, which FastAPI serves at `/docs`. - **Dashboard link:** [Dashboard.jsx:110](frontend/src/components/Dashboard.jsx#L110) has `API docs ↗`. - **Dev proxy:** [vite.config.js:13-14](frontend/vite.config.js#L13-L14) proxies `/docs` and `/openapi.json` to the backend, so the link works under the Vite dev server. - **README mentions:** [backend/README.md:114](backend/README.md#L114) says the frontend proxies `/api` and `/docs` to the backend. [backend/README.md:141](backend/README.md#L141) says the numerical endpoints are available in `/docs`. - **App setup:** [main.py:24](backend/app/main.py#L24) creates `FastAPI(title="Tangerine resilience engine")` with the default docs settings. That means Swagger UI is at `/docs` and ReDoc is at `/redoc`. Nothing links to `/redoc`. If you'd like links to the upstream FastAPI documentation as well, I can add them to the README.

Once the backend is running, you can open the auto-generated docs at these URLs:

- **Swagger UI:** http://localhost:8000/docs, or http://localhost:5173/docs through the Vite proxy during `npm start`.
- **ReDoc:** http://localhost:8000/redoc. This one isn't proxied by Vite, so use port 8000.
- **Raw OpenAPI schema:** http://localhost:8000/openapi.json

The "API docs ↗" link on the dashboard goes to `/docs`.
